prompts.text: factory_dispatch prompt; isolated worktree; SRAM-panel syndrome LUT against the encoder's executable convention pin.

notes: 7 cells (pack24 -> 3 syndrome-mask cells -> correct -> emit + embedded SramController), 2026/4096 sparse panel words, 1 attempt, first-build green through the REAL PanelDriver, autonomous. Design call stated loudly: ONE 16-bit panel word per syndrome — the 12-bit DATA-half error pattern only (the parity-half is dead state since only data bits egress) — beating the dispatched two-word sketch; and the stored-value-can-be-0 trap DISSOLVES by design (s=0, parity-only, and uncorrectable syndromes all correctly read 0 = no-op), so every codeword takes one uniform panel read. Known limit proven exhaustively: all 10,626 weight-4 patterns never alias (data half passes through); >=5 may miscorrect (bounded-distance). 45 tests incl. exhaustive 1-error through the real panel + corrupted-LUT mutation asserting the exact wrong output. Also fixed a stale duplicate NEEDS_BESPOKE dict key silently shadowing the VaricodeDecoder entry.
